preset.name: vc17win64-godot-gpu
preset.comment: Win64 static libs plus the CUDA GPU projects, with the static CRT, for the Godot godot_physx module built with physx_gpu=yes.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_STATIC_LIBRARIES
cmakeSwitch.comment: Static CPU libraries, linked into the module.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_PROJECTS
cmakeSwitch.comment: Build the CUDA GPU projects (needs the CUDA Toolkit at build time).

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_STATIC_LIBRARIES
cmakeSwitch.comment: PhysXGpu ships as a DLL; the core links a small loader.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_REDUCED_ARCHITECTURES
cmakeSwitch.comment: Fewer SM architectures for a much faster CUDA compile; widen if you need older/newer GPUs.

cmakeSwitch.name: NV_USE_STATIC_WINCRT
cmakeSwitch.comment: /MT static CRT, to match Godot's use_static_cpp.

cmakeSwitch.name: NV_USE_DEBUG_WINCRT
cmakeSwitch.comment: /MT (not /MTd) in all configs, to match the Godot editor build.

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
cmakeParam.comment: Install path, relative to the PhysX SDK root.
